decision.why: Vision achieved 3.1% melody error versus 66.9% for enlarged Audiveris, zero chord sequence errors, and seven parseable pilot outputs. Corrected evaluation found zero failures in seven upward-major-second transposition checks; the previous four failures were checker false positives. The goal remains unmet: four melody errors persist, 25 development excerpts remain untested with vision, chord timing is unaudited, and musician review is absent. The experiment budget is exhausted.
decision.hypothesis: Vision improves recognition on this pilot; broader musical correctness and general transposition reliability remain unestablished.
decision.expected_observation: Retain the best evaluated candidate while reporting the goal unmet and limiting transposition evidence to the tested upward major second. Further validation requires all 32 excerpts, melody corrections, chord-timing audits and musician review.
